name: focusflow
description: An adaptive, AI-assisted planner for balanced study and lifestyle schedules.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @focusflow/contracts && npm run build -w @focusflow/api && npm run build -w @focusflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @focusflow/api && node scripts/python-command.mjs -m pytest services/scheduler/tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @focusflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @focusflow/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @focusflow/api && npm run lint -w @focusflow/web
